**Finding: missing (LOL-CAP)** — validated and submitted.

**Investigation.** I read the full body (sec-1.4 covering §§1.4–5.3, sec-5.4 covering §§5.4–10.8) and ran targeted searches for "liability", "consequential damages", "indemnify" and warranty disclaimers. Results:

- §9 (Warranties) contains only mutual corporate reps plus the Globix acknowledgement — no disclaimer, no damages exclusion.
- §8 (Confidentiality) imposes mutual confidentiality duties (HDI at 8.2, Company at 8.3) but no liability limit.
- §10.1–10.8 are pure boilerplate; the only "liability" hits (p0061, p0062) are no-joint-venture language, not a cap.
- Fees are real and measurable (§3.1: 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month), so a 12-month fees basis is not illusory.

No cap exists anywhere, so both parties are exposed at law — a total failure of the fallback, not a mere sub-element gap.

**Cure.** One `insert_after` at p0070 adding §10.9, drafted to carry only the six fallback elements: a mutual aggregate cap at fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. I deliberately did not chase the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor (which, given deal size, would raise our own exposure as Customer), nor the data-protection/fraud/IP and payment-obligation elements — those are noted for negotiation rather than drafted in, since the checklist ceiling at fallback is satisfied. Existing §10.7 survival already sweeps Section 10, so no collateral edits were needed.
